item.title: Version 0.2.6
item.description:
• Added a new Settings toggle "Auto-connect on launch" — when enabled, the app automatically connects to VPN about 5 seconds after launch
  • The auto-connect only fires when setup is complete (all required fields filled), so it never triggers spurious failures on a half-configured install
  • Once the auto-connect handshake succeeds, the existing network-drop auto-reconnect path takes over, so switching WiFi or sleeping/waking transparently recovers the tunnel

item.title: Version 0.2.5
item.description:
Hotfix — strongly recommended for v0.2.3 / v0.2.4 users.

  • Fixed a case where a failed openconnect handshake could leave a zombie child behind, with vpnc-script's DNS and route mutations applied but never reverted — symptom: "WiFi connected but nothing has network access" until the user quit the app. connect() now always SIGTERMs any residual child on failure so vpnc-script's disconnect phase runs and restores DNS/routes.
  • Pre-connect route flush now only deletes when the kernel returns a concrete IPv4 destination. Previously, when no dedicated host route existed, `route get` fell through to the default route (destination="default") and the subsequent delete wiped the system default route.

item.title: Version 0.2.4
item.description:
• Log files are now split by day — ~/Library/Logs/VPNMenuBar/vpnmenubar-YYYY-MM-DD.log — so individual files stay small and are easy to pick through by date when reporting issues
  • Logs older than 14 days are auto-purged at launch, no disk buildup
  • "Show Logs…" and Settings → Reveal in Finder now always land on the current day's file

item.title: Version 0.2.3
item.description:
• Pre-connect route flush is now unconditional — fixes the case where a cached host route to the VPN gateway looks "correct" (matches the default gateway) but traffic still fails to route after a WiFi/network change
  • Previously the cleanup only deleted routes that looked obviously stale; now it always flushes before spawning openconnect, because at that moment no active tunnel exists and the kernel rebuilds the route on the next packet
  • Each connect attempt now logs the pre-connect flush result (route IP, previous gateway, delete success/failure) so "stuck" connections are diagnosable from the log

item.title: Version 0.2.2
item.description:
• Auto-strip whitespace and invisible characters (zero-width, NBSP, full-width space, newlines) from credential fields on save AND on load — fixes silent failures from pasting values out of chat apps / PDFs
  • Added persistent file log at ~/Library/Logs/VPNMenuBar/vpnmenubar.log covering launch banner, full connect flow, dependency checks, network/interface changes, unexpected disconnects, and dependency-install results
  • Added "Show Logs…" menu item and "Reveal in Finder" button under Settings for quick access to the log
  • Sensitive fields (password prefix, TOTP secret, generated code) are never written to the log

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
• Redesigned status bar icon: white badge with cutout shield and colored status dot
  • Gateway and server cert pin are now required fields in onboarding
  • Settings save now closes the window and auto-reconnects
  • Save button disabled when no changes are made
  • Added About window with version info and GitHub link

item.title: Version 0.2.0
item.description:
• Added auto-update via Sparkle — future updates install with one click
  • Added "Check for Updates" menu item
